title: ICA1L stabilizes LRP1 to mitigate Aβ pathology in Alzheimer’s disease
title_zh: ICA1L 稳定 LRP1 以缓解阿尔茨海默病中的 Aβ 病理
abstract: Abstract Background Genetic and proteomic studies have identified numerous candidate genes associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet the functional relevance of many remains unclear. Islet Cell Autoantigen 1 Like (ICA1L) has consistently emerged as a top-ranked locus in integrative genome-wide and proteome-wide association studies, but its mechanistic role in AD pathogenesis has not been defined. Methods ICA1L expression was examined in postmortem human AD brains and 5xFAD transgenic mice. Cognitive function and amyloid pathology were assessed using three independent ICA1L -deficient mouse models, including germline knockout, central nervous system-specific and excitatory neuron–specific knockouts. Hippocampal ICA1L overexpression was employed to evaluate the effects of enhanced ICA1L expression in vivo. ICA1L-interacting proteins were identified by immunoprecipitation followed by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS). Protein stability and degradation pathways were assessed using cycloheximide chase assays together with ubiquitination and inhibitor-based analyses. A structure-guided 30–amino acid ICA1L-derived peptide was engineered and evaluated for blood–brain barrier penetration and therapeutic efficacy in 5xFAD mice. Results ICA1L expression was significantly upregulated in the brains of AD patients and 5xFAD mice. Genetic ablation of ICA1L markedly exacerbated cognitive deficits and amyloid-β (Aβ) pathology, whereas hippocampal overexpression of ICA1L attenuated amyloid deposition and improved cognitive function. Interactomics analyses revealed that ICA1L physically interacts with low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1 (LRP1). Loss of ICA1L accelerated LRP1 degradation via ubiquitin–proteasome pathways, resulting in increased BACE1 expression and enhanced Aβ production. Notably, a 30–amino acid synthetic peptide derived from ICA1L stabilized LRP1, alleviated Aβ pathology, and improved cognitive performance in 5xFAD mice. Conclusions These findings identify ICA1L as an endogenous neuroprotective regulator of AD pathology and uncover a previously unrecognized ICA1L–LRP1 axis that modulates Aβ homeostasis. Targeting ICA1L or its active peptide represents a promising therapeutic strategy for Alzheimer’s disease.
abstract_zh: 背景：遗传学和蛋白质组学研究已识别出许多与阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关的候选基因，但其功能相关性仍不清楚。胰岛细胞自身抗原 1 类似物（ICA1L）在整合基因组全基因组和蛋白质组全关联研究中始终排名靠前，但其在 AD 病理中的机制尚未阐明。方法：在 AD 患者的尸检脑组织和 5xFAD 转基因小鼠中检测 ICA1L 表达。通过三种独立的 ICA1L 缺失小鼠模型（全基因组敲除、中央神经系统特异性敲除和兴奋性神经元特异性敲除）评估认知功能和淀粉样蛋白病理。使用海马体 ICA1L 过表达来评估体内增强 ICA1L 表达的影响。通过免疫沉淀结合液相色谱-串联质谱（LC‑MS）鉴定 ICA1L 互作蛋白。使用环己酰胺追踪实验以及泛素化和抑制剂分析评估蛋白稳定性和降解途径。设计并评估了一种结构引导的 30‑氨基酸 ICA1L 衍生肽的血脑屏障渗透性和在 5xFAD 小鼠中的治疗效果。结果：ICA1L 在 AD 患者和 5xFAD 小鼠的大脑中显著上调。ICA1L 的基因敲除显著加重认知缺陷和 Aβ 病理，而海马体 ICA1L 过表达则减轻淀粉样沉积并改善认知功能。互作组学分析显示 ICA1L 与低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白 1（LRP1）物理相互作用。ICA1L 缺失加速 LRP1 通过泛素‑蛋白酶体途径降解，导致 BACE1 表达上升和 Aβ 产生增强。值得注意的是，一种由 ICA1L 衍生的 30‑氨基酸合成肽可稳定 LRP1，缓解 Aβ 病理，并改善 5xFAD 小鼠的认知表现。结论：这些发现将 ICA1L 确定为一种内源性神经保护调节因子，并揭示了此前未被认识的 ICA1L‑LRP1 轴，该轴调节 Aβ 代谢。靶向 ICA1L 或其活性肽代表了阿尔茨海默病的有前景的治疗策略。
